Y4: jagatera bastu yata,    baddha saba sbabhābataḥ,
sama bā adhika taba,    sbabhābataḥ asambhaba,
Y5: dayālu, madhura, sama,    kṛtī, sthira, sarbottama,
e bhaktibinoda chāra,    kṛtāñjali bāra bāra,
Y6: tomāra gambhīra mana,    nāhi bujhe anya jana,
e saba baidika līlā,    icchāmātra prakāśilā,
tomāte bimukha ha’ye,    majila abidyā la’ye,
punaḥ yadi bhakti kari’,    bhaje bhaktasaṅga dhari’,
Y7: māyābaddha yatakṣaṇa,    thāke ta’ jībera mana,
parabyoma jñānamaya,    tāhe taba sthiti haya,
tomāra sundara rūpa,    here’ taba aparūpa,
Y8: dharmaniṣṭhā nāhi mora,    ātmabodha bā sundara,
taba pādamūle painu,    tomāra śaraṇa lainu,
e bhaktibinoda kā̃de,    hṛde dhairya nāhi bā̃dhe,
ahaitukī kṛpā kari’,    ei duṣṭajane hari,
Y9: hena duṣṭa karma nāi,    yāhā āmi kari nāi,
gati nāhi dekhi’ āra,    kā̃di hari anibāra,
yā tomāra haya mane,    daṇḍa deo akiñcane,
kleśa-bhoga bhāgye yata,    bhoga mora ha·u tata,
ye ye daśā bhogi āmi,    āmāke nā chāḓa sbāmi!
